params.body:
## Why

The photo tab of the vehicle sheet has a checkbox per tile and bulk actions (remove background, duplicate, delete), but no way to take the whole set. Twenty photos meant twenty clicks before you could delete them. Shane asked for a "selecteer alles".

This was meant as a second commit on #281, but the workbench opens one pull request per run and cannot append to an open one. #281 has since merged, so this branch is rebased on it and carries the master checkbox alone.

## What

A master checkbox in the toolbar row of the own offer grid, next to "Enkel met achtergrond", and the same control in the bulk bar of the platform (blurred) grid. Those are the two grids on the tab that already had a bulk selection; nothing else on the tab selects in bulk.

Unchecked selects, checked clears, and it shows the indeterminate state (`aria-checked="mixed"`) when only some tiles are selected.

Two rules carry it:

- **It selects what is visible.** The own grid has a filter that hides tiles, and a master checkbox that quietly took the hidden ones too would delete photos the dealer never saw selected. `visibleBoxes()` reads the same `enkelBg` flag the filter reads, so there is one answer to what is on screen: with the filter on, "all" is those tiles and the hidden ones keep whatever state they had. The platform grid has no filter, so there "visible" is the whole set.
- **It is not a second bookkeeping.** The per-tile checkboxes stay the truth. `tel()` reads them and derives the counters (`visible`, `visibleSel`), so ticking every tile by hand turns the master checkbox on and unticking one puts it back to indeterminate. No list of selected ids lives anywhere.

Wiring: `aria-controls` names the grid (`own_photos_grid`, `platform_photos_grid` — the two `<ul>`s gained those ids), `aria-checked` reports true / false / mixed, and `x-effect` keeps the native `indeterminate` property in step. The label is `ui.select_all`.

The Alpine bindings use `!==` rather than `>` and `<` deliberately: an attribute value carrying a bare `>` ends the tag for a naive parser, and it broke the test's own attribute reader first.

**Translations.** `ui.select_all` in nl, fr, en and de, next to `ui.background_after_removal`. Spanish had no `resources/lang/es/ui.php` at all, so every `ui.*` key already fell back to English for a Spanish dealer; this adds that file with the one key. Keys not in it keep falling back per key, exactly as before.

**Unchanged on purpose:** the Alpine state that was already there (`fotoview`, `enkelBg`, `sel`, `selBg`, `tel()`), every `onclick`, and every id and class `resources/js/**` selects on (`image_checkbox`, `image_stocklist_checkbox`, `existing_images`, `existing_stocklist_images`, `existing_image`, `removebg_selected`, `duplicate_selected`, `delete_selected`, `background-switch-wrapper`). Grepped for each before touching the file.

## Screenshots

`bgsample-{before,after}-{1280,390}.png` and `selectall-after-{1280,390}-filter-on.png`: the toolbar before, after with the filter off, and after with the filter on and everything selected (four of six tiles, the counter saying four).

## Checked

- Driven in a browser against the real stylesheet and Alpine, with the markup as the blade renders it. Master on with no filter selects all six; off clears; with the filter on it selects exactly the four visible and leaves the two hidden untouched; unticking one by hand gives `indeterminate` + `aria-checked="mixed"`; ticking it back gives checked; switching the filter off then reports mixed, because four of six are selected.
- New `tests/Feature/PhotoSelectAllTest.php` (4 tests, 39 assertions): the control exists in both grids with its label, `aria-controls` and the mixed state; the label is translated in all five locales; the master follows the filter and reads the tiles rather than keeping its own list; the styling rule exists.
- `php artisan view:cache` and `php -l` over all compiled views: clean. `npm run build`: green.
- `phpunit --filter 'SmokeTest|StylesheetSyntaxTest|UiApiUsageTest|ClassReferencesResolveTest|Vehicle|Photo'`: 245 tests, the same 7 failures as on an untouched baseline of this checkout (`OwnVehicleAuthorizationTest` x6, `VehicleSheetEmptyAmountTest` x1), unrelated to this change.
params.title: Photo tab: select all photos
